system.description: The Stormkelt’s voice resounds mightily, which affects three listeners of the dimwalker’s choosing within range. The chosen characters must make a Situation roll with a Situation value of 6 (Psyche modifiers apply). If any target fails the Situation roll, they instinctively obey the Stormkelt for the duration. However, the target will never do anything that causes self-harm (such as jumping off a cliff) or that demands initiative and creativity (such as formulating a plan or improvising).
